title: contract.offered
description: SPECULATIVE. A blanket/outline agreement — the 4th textbook procurement object: volume pricing over a term. Matches recurring purchase patterns in other firms' event history; the graduation of a monthly pooled-purchase into a standing agreement.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from the gerp's settings. The publication rule's filter — a private gerp's events never leave the operator plane.

customer_id.description: Emitting tenant (gerp_id). Redundant with the envelope account id but saves consumers a join.

items.description: The requested/offered lines. catalog_key is the SKU half of an item id (location-free — the counterparty's own items live at their own locations).

unit.description: Unit of measure; defaults to the item's own.

pricing.description: Free-form pricing commitment, e.g. '$11.20/lb up to 500lb/mo'.
